routeElectionAnswer.basis: Answered per official form, read first-hand from the exact SHA-256-pinned bytes. (1) CrRLJ 09.0100 rev. 11/2024 (wa_vac_domestic_violence): the face carries the route's ground - section 6 '[ ] Domestic Violence', RCW 9.96.060(2)(f) - so the byte-identical packet was missing a route election; repaired as bytes per the SD pattern, marking exactly that control. (2) CR 08.0900 rev. 07/2025 (wa_vac_felony): the face carries route-determined elections (section I movant Defendant; section 3 was-discharged, required for class B and C alike per CR 08.0930; section 4 no-charges-pending, RCW 9.94A.640(2)(a)); repaired as bytes, marking exactly those three; the class B/C timing boxes are case facts, never marked, disclosed to the participant. (3) CrRLJ 09.0800 rev. 07/2022 (wa_vac_cannabis): the face carries NO ground election at all; the dedicated single-ground form is itself the election, recorded as routeSelectionId without byte change. (4) CrRLJ 09.0100 for wa_vac_homicide_victim_prostitution: the face carries elections but NONE naming RCW 9.96.060(7) and no provision for a family-member application on behalf of a deceased victim; marking any printed ground would misstate the route -> BLOCKED_LEGAL_INPUT with the exact question recorded in the family's route-options-block.json. The shared WA host now carries ROUTE_ELECTION_MARKS with pinned control ids, context fragments and geometry; the SD routeSelectionId convention is adopted in the repaired families' product-wiring.json.
